meta.parties: The Baptist Missionary Society Corporation v. Jayawardene Et Al

rules.statement: The plaintiff corporation can hold more than 2 acres of land in Ceylon under the English Companies' Act, and the possession of the land was given to the plaintiff corporation together with two adjoining lands.
rules.supporting_quote: "I am also of opinion that section 21 of the Companies' Act is municipal in its effect, and there is nothing to prevent the plaintiff corporation from holding more than 2 acres of land in Ceylon. ... I am also of opinion on the evidence that the possession of this land was given to the plaintiff corporation, together with the two adjoining lands, Ambagahawatta and Coangahawatta, at the same time."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 21 of the English Companies' Act, 1862
